name: View-Dependent Working Set Generation
definition: An incremental refinement procedure that constructs the current view-dependent working set by refining a sorted set of visible non-empty nodes initialized with the octree root. It hides out-of-core data access latency by performing data access requests asynchronously.
summary: View-Dependent Working Set Generation dynamically adapts octree refinement based on screen-space size and visibility to hide out-of-core data latency, unlike static culling methods.
